title: ZA Bank — minimum and maximum amount for each currency exchange transaction
currencyNote: The bank calls its offshore renminbi account CNY; the journey ledger uses CNH. These are input amount limits for an exchange of that balance, not mainland remittance or stock-account limits.
scope: The calculator exchanges the received non-USD balance in one transaction at the selected bank. It does not silently split that transaction or infer a different currency's input limit from an output amount.
